sources.title: Whisper-Base - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Whisper-Base Transformer‑based automatic speech recognition (ASR) model for multilingual transcription and translation available on HuggingFace. HuggingFace Whisper‑Base ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) model is a state‑of‑the‑art system designed for transcribing spoken language into written text.

sources.title: whisper-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Base remains the sweet spot for general-purpose multilingual systems. whisper-small.en by openai offers English-only optimization at 244M parameters, balancing accuracy and speed better than base for English-dominant workloads but dropping multilingual support entirely.
